title: Image Sparks Controversy
subtitle: A small image has caused a big stir in a photography contest
excerpt: Dr Ning Xu denies breaking rules in contest
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A photography contest is at the center of a big controversy due to a small image.

Photography Contest

Dr Ning Xu participated in the Small World In Motion contest, sponsored by Nikon, and denies having broken the contest's rules.

Dr Ning Xu's participation in the contest has generated a big controversy surrounding the presented image.

Contest Rules

Photography contests usually have specific rules that participants must follow to ensure the integrity of the competition.

These rules can range from how images should be captured to the allowed editing.

  • Participants must know and respect the rules to avoid controversy.
  • Clarity of rules is fundamental to avoid misunderstandings.

The controversy surrounding Dr Ning Xu's image highlights the importance of clear and respected rules in photography contests.

With information from BBC News.
